doc.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Juggernaut band and Joe Williams
summary: He was in the first Juggernaut band with Kamuca, Royal, Cooper and Powell, and toured France with Joe Williams.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You were part of the Jauggernaut?

Yeah I was with the first band, yeah. Richie Kamuca was the other tenor and mostly the same players that he has right now. Marshall Royal was first alto. Buster Cooper, Benny Powell. It was fun playing.
And you know, music is eternal.
Did you ever have occasion to play behind Joe Williams and some of the other singers?

Yeah, I went to France with Joe Williams, I forget how long ago, oh, five years ago, where he took a small group, two horns and a rhythm section to do a festival in southern France. I’ve played with Joe many times. But not for long periods of time or anything like that, just like being on the same venue.
